Hi Maya / Grace,

Please find attached our proposed DPA with in-line comments (DPA_Cleargate_Redline.docx). I’ve highlighted three items that typically require conversation for enterprise customers:

1) Data retention and deletion (Section 6): our standard is 3 years for logs and 7 years for transactional records tied to billing/audit. We are open to a negotiated retention schedule scoped to the product.
2) SCCs (Appendix): we use the EU SCCs via standard addendum; if ClearGate needs an alternate flow we can accommodate with a brief onboarding form.
3) Subprocessors: we provide a current subprocessors list and commit to 30-day notice of material changes. We cannot accept open-ended vendor approval clauses.

If ClearGate needs a shorter retention than our baseline, Finance has asked Legal to escalate deviations >5 years for exec approval. Please let us know the specific retention target you need.

On signatory: we typically execute DPAs via DocuSign with our Head of Legal or Head of Ops signing depending on contract type. I’ll confirm the signer once terms are finalized.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
